role: Prospective fresh independent AMI far-field source selection, not inference preregistration
selection: All16 sessions in pinned official Kaldi AMI evaluation split, one original microphone each; no score-dependent selection. Any target-containing/invalid source stops preparation, with no replacement or silent exclusion.
protocol: Push selection and code before audio download. Never train/tune on these recordings. Freeze source hashes after acquisition. Only after candidate is fixed from development data, push separate model/threshold/engine/scorer preregistration before any inference. Complete all16 sources and preserve failures; no threshold tuning from final outcomes.
limits: Sixteen participants recur over four meeting groups; not16 independent meetings by speaker. Far-field dialogue domain only, transcript screen not full phonetic truth. This source preparation cannot establish full goal, positive recall or latency.
